required_invariants: a receipt for the prior attempt never changes active-attempt status
matching the logical operation id without matching the attempt is insufficient
only an EFFECT_CONFIRMED receipt bound to the active operation id and attempt confirms the active effect
only an active-attempt CANCEL_CONFIRMED receipt before EMITTED permits retry
a delayed active-attempt CANCEL_CONFIRMED after EMITTED leaves UNKNOWN and cannot permit retry
contradictory effect and cancel receipts for one active attempt produce CONFLICT_UNKNOWN in either arrival order
neutral input release never proves semantic cancellation or authorizes retry
post-EMITTED unresolved state is UNKNOWN and never authorizes duplicate retry
hypothesis: A latest-receipt comparator that ignores operation identity will falsely complete or unsafely retry at least one enumerated schedule; strict operation-id and attempt binding will avoid all stale-receipt misattribution while preserving valid active receipts and safe pre-emission retries.
method_pass: Independent raw-only reconstruction matches every schedule and decision; strict policy has zero stale-ACK influence, false completion, false cancellation, or unsafe retry; valid active effect/cancel receipts retain their intended decisions; late cancel receipts and contradictory ACK pairs remain unresolved with no retry; neutral release never changes operation status; and every frozen mutation control is rejected.
hypothesis_support: The faulty comparator misclassifies at least one schedule and strict binding removes all such misclassifications without losing any valid active receipt or safe retry.
mutation_controls: accept an earlier operation-id receipt as active completion
accept a reused operation-id receipt from the wrong attempt
accept a stale cancellation receipt as retry authority
collapse contradictory active-attempt ACKs to completion
collapse contradictory active-attempt ACKs to cancellation and retry
let neutral release prove semantic cancellation
admit retry while active effect is committed
drop a valid active effect acknowledgement

HTDCU.H: For a non-idempotent GUI-like action retried as a distinct attempt, an identity-blind receipt reducer will falsely complete an active attempt or authorize an unsafe retry from an older or contradictory ACK; binding both operation ID and attempt will remove those errors while preserving valid active ACKs and safe pre-emission retries.
HTDCU.T: Enumerate all valid combinations of five lifecycle phases, post-emission committed/uncommitted state, 17 named receipt timelines including reused operation IDs, both contradictory active-ACK orders, retry request, neutral-release observation, and one no-input control. Compare an identity-blind phase-aware reducer with an operation-ID-and-attempt-bound reducer; reconstruct raw schedules and decisions independently and apply nine frozen decision mutations.

D.METHOD_PASS_SCOPED: Independent schedule and decision reconstruction agrees on every row; strict policy has zero false completion, false cancellation, stale-ACK influence, unsafe retry, or unresolved contradictory-ACK retry; valid current ACK decisions are preserved; all nine mutations are rejected.
D.SUPPORT_FOR_ID_ATTEMPT_BINDING_SCOPED: The identity-blind comparator makes at least one false completion, false cancellation, or unsafe retry, and strict binding removes all such errors without losing any valid active ACK or safe retry.
D.NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_SCOPED: The identity-blind comparator and strict reducer make the same status and retry decision for every enumerated schedule.
D.FAIL_METHOD: Any stale ACK changes active status, a neutral release proves semantic cancellation, a contradictory receipt pair is resolved as completed/canceled or permits retry, or a retry can duplicate an unresolved/committed operation.
D.HOLD_MODEL_UNIDENTIFIABLE: Operation identity, attempt boundary, lifecycle phase, or ACK semantics cannot be specified for a later backend transfer.

HTDCU.C: If a real backend guarantees globally unique operation IDs per dispatched attempt and emits only one authoritative terminal ACK per operation, the attempt and contradictory-ACK cases may be defensive rather than observed failure modes. The finite model does not establish those backend guarantees.
HTDCU.U: This is authored finite-model evidence only. It does not measure race frequency or prove OS/backend behavior, GUI effect, task completion, latency, token benefit, portability, production safety, or a generic cancellation guarantee.
